source: Synthetic, against the public sample app (alexabreu/alexabreu-factory-foreman-sample). Seeded defects: remove() mutates the list it was given; countUnread() is an extraction that adds nothing. Bait: style choices that are not defects.
task: Review this slice as the code reviewer. The pull request description and the diff are below. Report findings only for things that should change, each with the file and line, why it matters, and the fix.
notes: Changed 12 Nov, after results were seen: the case first seeded "undo() restores by a stale index" as a defect. It isn't one for AC-2: add() appends (sample src/reading-list.ts:25 at 0a8c609, `items: [ ...list.items, { id: list.nextId, ... } ]`), so a book added between remove and undo lands after every existing item and the stored index still points at the original position. test/evals.test.mjs replays the diff's remove and undo with an appending add to show it. The check was removed and stored outputs for the current reviewer and the candidate were re-scored from their saved replies, with no new runs.
